title: One scrollbar and one width for every Claude screen
notes:
Main's Claude screen and a worker's Claude screen look different (screenshot from the user, 2026-11-07):
- Scrollbar: app.css themes scrollbars with :not(.pane, .pane *)::-webkit-scrollbar, so a worker screen, which sits inside .pane, gets the system's wide grey bar. Main gets the app's bar, 10px with a 3px transparent border, which leaves a 4px thumb: too thin. Fix: exclude only what draws its own (the xterm), not the whole pane, and make the visible thumb 7px, the user's number. One rule for every app scrollbar.
- Width: .chat is width min(100%, 110ch) in main's column, so main's conversation is a centred strip with wide empty gutters, while .pane-screen > .chat is 100%. The user prefers the worker's: main's screen fills its column too, same padding as a worker screen or close to it.

CSS only; no test (no DOM environment). Hand check in the app: both screens' scrollbars match at 7px, a terminal pane's scrolling is unchanged, main's text fills the column. Docs: the chat README's layout line if it names the measure, history.
